title: Cardano Autonomous Agent Testing: CIP-1694 Voltaire Testing

ms.promise:
・Defining agents, agent behaviors
・Building agent scheduling architecture
・Building a PoC agent scheduling infrastructure
・Basic UI for adding agents, agent behaviors
・Basic UI for dashboard
ms.criteria:
・Architecture document is published to a public GitHub repo.
・PoC of agent scheduling infrastructure is created
・Figma design for the dashboard is published.
ms.report:
For the proof of achievement, please refer to the following resources:
・Deployed Platform: https://agents.cardanoapi.io/
・Source Code: https://github.com/cardanoapi/autonomous-agents
・Figma Design: https://www.figma.com/design/h9K0eArOSnZOVw7O5UrYFu/AAT?node-id=552-18675&t=6F7jU9q6kL6rpaRI-0
・Documentation: https://cardanoapi.github.io/autonomous-agents/docs/architecture

For this milestone, our deliverables were the designs (Figma) and the architecture document. The links to these resources are mentioned above.
Regarding the outputs we aimed to achieve for this milestone, we have defined the agents and their behaviors, and represented them in the Figma UI. We also worked on building the agent scheduling architecture and completed a PoC for the scheduling architecture. The agents and their behaviors are designed in Figma (Link 3) and are live on the deployed platform (Link 1). The architecture document covers the agent scheduling architecture. For the PoC, we have a deployed environment (Link 1) where agents can be created and run using Docker.
Addressing the Acceptance Criteria:
・The architecture document has been published to a public GitHub repository (Link 4).
・The PoC for the agent scheduling infrastructure has been created and is available on the deployed platform (Link 1).
・The Figma design for the dashboard has been published (Link 3).

ms.report:
> API and Dashboard is deployed and private test with selected members is possible. A video proof of the platform submitted.
Here is the deployed platform that anybody can test. 
・https://agents.cardanoapi.io/ (sanchonet network)
・https://preview.agents.cardanoapi.io/ (preview network)

The platform is public and open to anybody to use. We have also presented the platform to Governance tools working group in one of the weekly meetings.

> Video proof of the agents autonomously reacting to the network events.
